tools.name: silvasoft_list_relations
tools.description: List customers and suppliers (relations) with contact and address details. Returns at most 200 per call; use Offset with a stable Sorting to page. Silvasoft API: GET listrelations/.

tools.name: silvasoft_list_products
tools.description: List products (articles) with price, VAT and stock quantity. Use ArticleNumber or EAN for one exact product. Silvasoft API: GET listproducts.

tools.name: silvasoft_list_orders
tools.description: List sales orders, filtered by order date, change or creation time, or custom status. Silvasoft API: GET listorders/.

tools.name: silvasoft_list_sales_invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices, with optional invoice lines. Use InvoiceNumber for one invoice, or dates and OutstandingOnly to filter. Lines return at most 50 invoices per call. Silvasoft API: GET listsalesinvoices/.

tools.name: silvasoft_list_purchase_transactions
tools.description: List purchase invoices (supplier invoices) by number or date. Silvasoft API: GET listpurchasetransactions/.

tools.name: silvasoft_list_tax_codes
tools.description: List the tax codes configured in the administration, with their rate. Silvasoft API: GET listtaxcodes/.

tools.name: silvasoft_list_ledger_accounts
tools.description: List ledger accounts (grootboekrekeningen) for a fiscal year. Without FiscalYear, returns the latest year. Silvasoft API: GET listledgeraccounts/.

tools.name: silvasoft_list_day_registrations
tools.description: List day registrations (hours worked per user and day) for a date range. Silvasoft API: GET listdayregistrations/.

tools.name: silvasoft_add_business_relation
tools.description: Create a business customer or supplier. If a relation with the same e-mail, name or number exists, Silvasoft returns that relation and creates nothing. Silvasoft API: POST addbusinessrelation/.
